subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

Shyamali is / very / careful for / her health.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the improper use of the preposition "**for**" after "**careful**."
 
• The correct preposition should be "**about**" or "**with**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**careful about her health**" or "**careful with her health**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Shyamali is very careful about her health."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shyamali is** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **very** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **her health.** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
